change: All Resonance products are temporarily free while real usage, provider consumption, infrastructure cost, and support demand are measured.
details: New billing and checkout are paused during the Resonance Free Access Promotion. The Hub continues to record governed usage and cost signals so future pricing can be based on measured operating evidence rather than assumptions.

change: Full ePublisher access is free during the promotion while generation, publishing, export, and support costs are measured.
details: ePublisher commercial feature gates are paused during the promotion. Sign-in can still be required so projects persist and generation, export, storage, and support usage can be measured for sustainable future pricing.

change: Creative Studio generation access is temporarily free while image, media, storage, and provider costs are measured.
details: Creative Studio paid-generation gates are paused during the promotion. Operational telemetry remains active so real image, media, infrastructure, and support cost can inform a later pricing model.

change: Sync Vision storyboard, lipsync, rendering, and export access is included during the promotion while video-provider costs are measured.
details: Sync Vision commercial gates are paused during the promotion. Storyboard, lipsync, rendering, export, storage, and provider usage continue to be measured so future pricing can reflect actual cost.

change: YouTube Optimizer audits, thumbnail generation, and growth tools are temporarily free while AI usage and operating costs are measured.
details: YouTube Optimizer commercial gates are paused during the promotion. Audit, thumbnail, AI, and infrastructure usage remain measurable so a sustainable future pricing model can be based on real cost.

change: Career Compass remains free for schools and learners while report-generation, support, and delivery costs are measured.
details: Career Compass remains in an open free pilot for schools, counsellors, and learners. The pilot measures demand, support load, report-generation cost, and delivery requirements before any post-pilot commercial model is set.

change: New season live — free episodes, media kits, and shop. Never a subscription.
details: The new season is streaming on the podcast site with free episodes, downloadable media kits, and a merch shop. The podcast is intentionally never gated behind a subscription.

change: Resonance Constitutional Governance Framework v1.0 published — how we build, price, and evolve every app.
details:
RCGF v1.0 is the constitutional framework that governs how every Resonance app is built, priced, and evolved. It codifies our principles around user sovereignty, honest pricing, transparent AI usage, and pass/pack alignment across the ecosystem.

The framework is public, versioned, and referenced directly in the AI prompts that power our optimization protocol.
